llm.summary: This skill sends user-provided image prompts and reference images to the stated image API and saves generated image files locally, with the main risks disclosed to the user.

dimensions.detail: Network access, local image reads, output file writes, and USA_API_KEY access are proportionate for an image generation skill and are described in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No hidden install hook was found. The script uses uv script metadata to install requests and CustomTkinter when run, which is disclosed in the skill instructions.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions are mostly scoped to user-requested image generation and key setup. The configurable --base-url can send the API key to a non-default HTTP/HTTPS service, but this is documented and warned about.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: On Windows, the optional --configure-key flow saves USA_API_KEY to the current user's environment via a user-facing dialog. This is persistent credential storage, but it is user-directed and disclosed.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose is image generation/editing through usa0.top, and the script behavior matches that purpose: it reads an API key, sends prompts and optional images to an image endpoint, downloads image results, and writes output files.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, only use this with a dedicated, revocable usa0.top image-generation API key and avoid sensitive prompts or images. Do not use --base-url unless you explicitly trust the destination, because the API key and request content will be sent there.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: The sensitive capabilities noted by the scanner are real, but they align with the skill's image-generation purpose and are substantially disclosed in SKILL.md, including primaryEnv, network API use, local output files, and key-safety guidance.
[E1] expected: The script does transmit prompts, optional images, and an Authorization bearer token to the configured image API. That is expected for this API client, and the artifact explicitly warns that custom --base-url values will receive the API key.
